segments.normalizedSource: ```swift public class TypeWithSubject { public let publisher: some Publisher = PassthroughSubject<Int,Never>() } public class TypeWithErasedSubject { public let publisher: some Publisher = PassthroughSubject<Int,Never>() .eraseToAnyPublisher() } // In another module: let nonErased = TypeWithSubject() if let subject = nonErased.publisher as? PassthroughSubject<Int,Never> { print("Successfully cast nonErased.publisher.") } let erased = TypeWithErasedSubject() if let subject = erased.publisher as? PassthroughSubject<Int,Never> { print("Successfully cast erased.publisher.") } // Prints "Successfully cast nonErased.publisher." ```
segments.contextBefore: By comparison, `TypeWithErasedSubject.publisher` appears to callers as an [`AnyPublisher`](anypublisher.md), so you can change the underlying publisher type at will.
